thread:
Alex: Morning — I want to board the Wed release train. Wave A at 09:00 PT (canary) and Wave B at 09:30 PT. Who can own smoke + rollback for each? :wave:
Maria: I can take 09:00 canary. I’ll run the smoke checklist and validate metrics. :thumbsup:
Jamal: I’ll pick 09:30 wave B. Heads-up: there’s a small schema change in the user_events migration — will coordinate with DB team by EOD.
Grace: Quick Q — what’s the rollback procedure this time? Last train used the `rollback-tag` script, but we had to toggle routing in prod console.
sre-bot: Automated checklist: confirm canary owners, verify migration runbooks, ensure circuit-breaker thresholds set, SLO guardrails on. See snippet: `./scripts/deploy-checks --canary --metrics`
Maria: @Grace rollback is `deployctl rollback --tag <previous-build>` — also we keep the traffic-split at 5% for 15m then 25% if healthy. If latency > 500ms or error rate > 1% within 10m rollback immediately.
Alex: Thanks — Jamal, can you confirm DB change is backward-compatible for the old workers? If not we need to move migration to a separate window.
Jamal: Confirmed: migration is additive and has a backfill job. I'll post the migration runbook link in a sec.
Maria: For smoke I’ll run these checks: 1) /health 2) sample generation endpoint 3) embeddings baseline 4) end-to-end sign-in and inference. Any additional ones?
Grace: Add: token billing sanity check and latency histogram for 99th pct over the last hour. Also ensure alert rule `deploy_high_error_rate` is active.
Alex: Can someone own rollback rehearsals beforehand? I can block 30m on Tues for a quick dry-run.
Jamal: I’ll join. Will test `deployctl rollback` in staging and validate DB backfill can be paused.
Maria: Noted — I’ll prepare the smoke checklist as a gist and drop it here by EOD.
sre-bot: Reminder: create incident channel if you hit the rollback threshold. Use naming: `incident/release-<train>-<date>` and add oncall.
Grace: One more — can we pin the exact image tags for both waves? No floating `latest`.
Alex: Yes — tags will be `infra-service@sha:abc123` for canary, `infra-service@sha:def456` for wave. I’ll put them in the release manifest.
Maria: :rocket: Sounds good. I’ll claim 09:00 canary and post the smoke gist shortly.
Jamal: I’ve got 09:30. I’ll ping DB on migration gating and post runbook link here once live.
Alex: Perfect. If anything changes, please update this thread and the release manifest. Thanks everyone. :eyes:
